site.summary:
The public site lives in `src/app/[locale]/(site)/**`. Its layout wraps every page in `I18nProvider`, which ships only the `common` and `nav` namespaces, plus `AlternatesProvider`, a skip link, `SiteHeader`, `<main id="main">` and `SiteFooter`. Organization, Person and WebSite JSON-LD stream in behind a separate `<Suspense>`.

Static and streamed parts:
- `getLocale()` reads `next/root-params`, so each page shell is prerendered per locale.
- Every DB-backed part is an async server component that calls `await connection()` inside its own `<Suspense>`. It then reads `'use cache'` + `cacheTag("content")` functions from `src/server/modules/content/queries.ts`.
- The skeletons have the same box sizes as the real content, so nothing shifts when it streams in.
- No `loading.tsx` exists under `(site)`. Detail pages use the `params.then(...)` pattern inside `<Suspense fallback={<ArticleSkeleton/>}>`.

Home sections, in order:
1. Hero, with a streamed availability badge.
2. Trust marquee (streamed).
3. Featured work (streamed).
4. Services bento (streamed).
5. HowWeWork tabs (static, no JS).
6. Stats strip (streamed).
7. Latest posts plus a course card (streamed).
8. Testimonials (streamed).
9. CtaBand (static).

Client JS is kept small: header scroll state, active nav link, language dropdown, theme toggle, a mobile menu built on the native Popover API, next-themes, Radix `DirectionProvider`, and per-page islands (`LiteYouTube`, `CopyLink`, `ViewTracker`, `Toc`, `ContactForm`).

RTL is handled with logical utilities. Arrow icons are drawn for RTL and get `ltr:rotate-*`. The hero SVG mirrors with `rtl:-scale-x-100`, `gt-accent` flips its gradient under `[dir=rtl]`, and the marquee is forced `dir="ltr"`.

The current brand, a green two-square mark called "Good Team", is hard-coded in at least 10 places, including the OG renderer and the favicon.

files.role: Root layout for each locale (html lang/dir, fonts, theme init, Providers)
files.notes: `generateStaticParams` covers fa and en. `presetInitScript` is injected through `<InlineScript>` in `<head>`. `viewport.themeColor` is hard-coded to #ffffff / #141a21. Metadata title template is `%s | ${t.common.appName}`. `<body class="min-h-dvh">` wraps `<Providers dir>` (next-themes `attribute=class`, `defaultTheme=system`, plus Radix `DirectionProvider`).

files.role: Public chrome: the main mount point for a menu bar, dock and assistant
files.notes: Order: `I18nProvider(pickMessages(locale, ["common","nav"]))` > `AlternatesProvider` > skip link to `#main` > `<SiteHeader locale t/>` > `<main id="main" className="min-h-[60dvh] overflow-x-clip">` > `<SiteFooter/>` > `<Suspense fallback={null}><SiteJsonLd/></Suspense>` (calls `connection()` + `getPublicProfile()`, then emits organizationLd/personLd/websiteLd). There is no loading.tsx.

files.role: Home page (static shell plus streamed sections)
files.notes:
`generateMetadata` uses `pageMetadata({path:'/', title:t.site.metaTitle, absoluteTitle:true})`.

Sections in order:
(1) HERO `<section class=relative isolate>`. Background layer at `-top-16`: `bg-grid mask-radial` and two `gt-glow` blobs (primary/20, violet/15). Grid at `lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,1.05fr)]`. Left column (`gt-rise`):
  - `<Suspense fallback={AvailabilityBadgeSkeleton}><AvailabilityBadge/>` reads `getPublicProfile().availableForWork` and shows `site.available` or `site.unavailable`.
  - h1 `HeroTitle` wraps `site.heroAccent`… specifically `site.heroTitleAccent` (a substring of `site.heroTitle`) in `.gt-accent`.
  - `site.heroSubtitle`.
  - CTA links: `site.heroPrimaryCta` to /contact, `site.heroSecondaryCta` to /work.
  - Proof list: `site.heroProof1..3`.
  Right column: `<HeroDiagram/>` (static).
(2) `<Suspense fallback=TrustMarqueeSkeleton(h-[121px])><TrustMarquee/>`.
(3) Featured work: static `SectionHeading` (`site.workEyebrow`, `site.workTitle`, `site.workSubtitle`; action `ArrowLink` `site.viewAllWork` to /work), then `<Suspense FeaturedWorkSkeleton><FeaturedWork/>`.
(4) Services: section with a `mask-fade-y bg-muted/40` backdrop. `SectionHeading` uses `site.servicesEyebrow`, `servicesTitle`, `servicesSubtitle` and `allServices` (to /services), then `<Suspense><ServicesBento/>`.
(5) How we work: `SectionHeading` (`site.processEyebrow`, `processTitle`, `processSubtitle`, centered) plus `<HowWeWork/>`. Fully static.
(6) Stats: `<section aria-label={site.statsEyebrow}>`, a rounded-3xl card with `bg-dots`, then `<Suspense StatsStripSkeleton><StatsStrip/>`.
(7) Latest: `SectionHeading` (`site.latestEyebrow`, `latestTitle`, `latestSubtitle`, `readBlog` to /blog), then `<Suspense><LatestPosts/>`.
(8) `<Suspense TestimonialsSkeleton><Testimonials/>` (the whole section streams).
(9) `<CtaBand/>` (static).

Sections have no `id` or `data-*` hooks today.

files.role: Streamed home sections and their matching skeletons (server-only)
files.notes:
Every async section starts with `await connection()`.

- `AvailabilityBadge({t})`: `getPublicProfile()`; uses `.gt-live` dot (success or warning).
- `TrustMarquee({locale,t})`: `listPublicClientNames(locale)` (work `meta.client` plus testimonial companies). Renders only an h-px div when there are fewer than 2 names. Wrapper is `gt-marquee-wrap mask-fade-x` with `dir=ltr`; items are duplicated, with `aria-hidden` on the second copy. Key: `site.trustedBy`.
- `FeaturedWork`: `listPublished({locale, types:['work'], pageSize:12})`, sorted featured-first, top 3. `WorkCard size=lg` at `lg:col-span-7 row-span-2`, plus 2 cards at `lg:col-span-5`. Returns null when empty.
- `ServicesBento`: `listServices(locale)` (returns `highlights` bullets parsed from markdown), max 6. `bentoSpans = [md:col-span-4, 2, 2, 4]` on `md:grid-cols-6`. Big cards get `bg-dots` + `gt-glow` + highlight chips (`site.whatYouGet`). Uses `ServiceIcon(meta.icon)`.
- `StatsStrip`: `getSiteStats()` gives projectsDelivered, hoursTracked, clients and postsPublished. Keys: `site.statProjects`, `statHours`, `statClients`, `statPosts`. Grid is 2 columns, 4 at lg, with dashed-border index logic.
- `LatestPosts`: `listPublished({types:['article','vlog','tutorial'], pageSize:3})` + `listSeries(locale)`, then `getSeriesWithLessons(locale, course.slug)`. Shows 2 PostCards plus a dark course card when a course exists. Keys: `site.courseEyebrow`, `courseCta`, `minutesTotal`, `lessonsCount`.
- `Testimonials`: `listTestimonials(locale, 6)`, CSS columns 1/2/3. Keys: `site.testimonialsEyebrow`, `testimonialsTitle`.
- `CtaBand({locale,t,className})`: static and also reused on about, work, services and detail pages. Dark `bg-grey-900` panel with `bg-grid mask-radial` and glows. Keys: `site.ctaTitle`, `ctaSubtitle`, `ctaButton` (to /contact), `ctaSecondary` (to /services), `heroProof1..3`.

files.role: Static animated hero system diagram (Cloudflare-style), no JS
files.notes:
An `@container` box with `aspect-[6/5] max-w-[600px]`, sized in `cqw` units. The SVG uses `viewBox 0 0 600 500` with `rtl:-scale-x-100`. Paths come from `inputPath`/`outputPath`, with `.gt-ants` dashed lines and `.gt-packet` traveling dots. The hub orbit spins via `animate-[spin_40s]`.

Node boxes are positioned with `start-0`/`end-0` and `top%`. Keys: `site.diagramIdea`, `diagramDesign`, `diagramCode`, `diagramDeploy`, `diagramPortal`, `diagramAgents`. The hub shows `LogoMark` + `common.appName`. Floating cards use `animate-float`: a terminal (`dir=ltr`, macOS traffic lights #ff5f57/#febc2e/#28c840), a progress card (`site.diagramProgress`, `diagramLive`) and a toast (`site.diagramTasks`). The `#8e33ff` violet is hard-coded. `role=img` with `aria-label={site.diagramLabel}`.

files.role: Tabbed feature showcase with no JS (radio inputs + :has())
files.notes:
Tabs: portal, progress, contracts and invoices. Hidden radios `#how-<key>` live inside `fieldset.contents`, with labels as tabs. Panels show via `group-has-[#how-x:checked]:grid`. The literal class map `tabCls` is required because Tailwind cannot see interpolated class names.

Keys: `site.tab{Portal|Progress|Contracts|Invoices}`, `tab{K}Title`, `tab{K}Body`, `tab{K}Point1..3`, plus mock keys `mockProject`, `mockMilestone1-3`, `mockUpdate`, `mockHoursWeek`, `mockSigned`, `mockContract`, `mockInvoice`, `mockPaid`, and `common.total`.

On mobile the tabs scroll horizontally (`min-w-56 overflow-x-auto`); at lg they stack vertically. The bar chart is forced `dir=ltr`.

files.role: Public header (server component), the obvious seat for the macOS menu bar
files.notes:
Exports:
- `siteSections`: /work, /services, /blog, /learn and /about, with nav keys.
- `staticSitePaths`: those paths plus / and /contact, used by the language toggle.
- `SiteHeader({locale,t})`: `HeaderShell` > `max-w-7xl` row: `Logo` link, then a pill nav (`hidden md:flex`, `<NavLinks items/>`), then `LanguageMenu`, `ThemeToggle`, a contact CTA (`hidden sm:inline-flex`, label `site.heroPrimaryCta`) and `MobileMenu` (large links with `gt-menu-item` stagger `animationDelay i*40ms`).

The header is 64px tall (`h-16`), and the dock and menu bar will need to account for that.

- `HeaderShell`: one passive scroll listener sets `data-scrolled`, which turns on `.glass` and a border. The header is `sticky top-0 z-50 h-16`.
- `NavLinks` / `ActiveLinks`: `usePathname()` inside `<Suspense>`, with fallback links rendered without active state; sets `aria-current`.
- `LanguageMenu({current,label,staticPaths})`: Radix `DropdownMenu` with an icon trigger. `useSwitchHref` picks the alternates context first, then the same static path, then the section index. It uses a plain `<a>` (full reload) because a `<Link>` prefetch across root params 404s in Next 16.4.
- `MobileMenu({label,closeLabel,children})`: native `popover="auto"` with `id="site-mobile-menu"`, `popoverTarget` buttons, a `.gt-mobile-menu` full-screen sheet, and `CloseOnNavigate` (usePathname in Suspense calls `hidePopover`).

The header renders `ThemeToggle` from `components/shared/theme-controls.tsx`, which cycles light and dark and needs the `common` namespace through `useT`. `AppearanceMenu` (mode plus color preset) is used only by the panel header.

`CurrentYear` is `'use cache'` + `cacheLife('days')` (the pattern for any date or clock in static chrome). `FooterSocials` uses `connection()` + `getPublicProfile()` inside `<Suspense fallback h-9>`.

Layout: a 4-column grid `md:grid-cols-[1.5fr_1fr_1fr_1fr]` with columns `site.footerExplore`, `footerResources` (includes /feed.xml and /llms.txt with `prefetch=false`) and `footerConnect` (/login, /api/v1/openapi.json, /sitemap.xml). Below that sits the giant `.gt-wordmark` showing `common.appName`, then a bottom bar with `site.footerRights`, `footerMadeWith` and an RSS link. The footer has `mt-24` and dashed borders.

- `Container`: `mx-auto max-w-7xl px-4 sm:px-6`.
- `Eyebrow`: pill with a `.gt-dot`.
- `SectionHeading({eyebrow,title,subtitle,action,align,as})`: mb-10/12; with start alignment it becomes `md:flex-row` with the action at the end.
- `ArrowLink`: `ChevronLeftIcon ltr:rotate-180`.
- `PageHero({crumbs,eyebrow,title,subtitle,children})`: the hero for index pages, `bg-grid mask-fade-b` + `gt-glow` at `-top-16`.
- `Chip`: filter pill with `scroll=false`.
- Formatting helpers: `siteFmt`, `fmtDate(d, locale, 'medium'|'long')` (Jalali for fa), `fmtNum`.

This file is the natural home for new framed-grid primitives.

- `TypeBadge`.
- `PostCard` (`gt-lift`, `Cover` 16/10; falls back to `NoteCard` when `type==='note'`).
- `NoteCard` (dashed).
- `WorkCard({size:'md'|'lg'})`: metric overlay from `meta.metrics[0]`, client and year, stack chips in `dir=ltr`.
- `SeriesCard` (`gt-ring`).
- `TestimonialCard`: sets `lang`/`dir` per testimonial locale; `markdownToText(quote, 600)`.

Cards link through `after:absolute after:inset-0` stretched links.

Local `/media` and `/brand` images go through `next/image` (fill, sizes); external URLs use a plain lazy ``. When there is no cover it draws a deterministic gradient from a hard-coded palette (#00A76F, #078DEE, …) plus a grid and kind icon. Re-theme the palette for the new brand.

files.role: Small client islands for public pages
files.notes:
- `LiteYouTube`: click-to-load; the thumbnail is fetched only after window `load`, because the YouTube host is blocked on some networks.
- `CopyLink`.
- `ViewTracker`: sessionStorage dedupe, then `requestIdleCallback` calls `recordViewAction`.
- `Toc`: IntersectionObserver with `rootMargin "-80px 0px -70% 0px"`, tied to the 64px header.

Labels arrive as props so the `site` namespace never ships to the client. Follow the same convention for the assistant.

`AlternatesProvider` / `useAlternates` / `SetAlternates({value})`. Detail pages register their translations, and `LanguageMenu` reads them. Any new language control in a menu bar must use `useAlternates` and fall back to `staticSitePaths`.
Server-only. Chevrons use `ltr:rotate-180`.
`ArticleMeta`, `ArticleHeader`, `Tldr`, `ArticleBody` (`prose-gt` plus a `lg:sticky lg:top-24` TOC aside), `ShareBar`, `Syndicated`, `AuthorBox`. Used by blog, lessons and services.
`LessonList`, `LessonView` (sidebar at `lg:sticky lg:top-24`).
`JsonLd({data})` escapes `<`. Also: `ids`, `organizationLd`, `personLd`, `websiteLd`, `breadcrumbLd`, `faqLd`, `articleLd`, `videoLd`. Organization `logo` is `/icon.svg`.

`pageMetadata({locale,path,title,description,languages,type,image,markdownPath,noindex,absoluteTitle})` covers canonical, hreflang plus x-default, OG/Twitter, and the RSS and `.md` alternates. Also exports `absoluteUrl`, `samePathAlternates` and `postAlternates`.

`renderOgImage({locale,title,eyebrow,brand,footer,domain})`. It hard-codes the old green logo SVG and the green and violet glows and colors (#141A21 background). Fonts are TTF files from `public/fonts/og` (Satori cannot read woff2). Persian text is pre-shaped with `bidiRuns`/`visualRtl` from `src/lib/arabic-shaping.ts`. Used by `(site)/opengraph-image.tsx` (static), `blog/[slug]/opengraph-image.tsx` and `work/[slug]/opengraph-image.tsx` (both `connection()`).

files.role: FAQ on native <details> (no JS) + FAQPage JSON-LD
files.notes: `generalFaq(t)` uses `site.faq1Q..5A`. Styled by `.gt-faq`.
Native inputs and selects with no UI library, a honeypot field, posting to `submitContactAction` from leads. Labels come in as props.
`CardSkeleton`, `CardGridSkeleton`, `ArticleSkeleton`, `ChipsSkeleton`.

- social-links.tsx: `SocialLinks`, `SocialGlyph` (inline brand SVG paths).
- service-icon.tsx: the `serviceIcons` map, also imported by panel `content/_components/editor-data.ts`.
- page-utils.ts: `decodeParam`, `sp`, `pageParam`, `withQuery`, `notFoundMetadata`, `homeCrumb`.

All share the same skeleton: `PageHero` (breadcrumbs, title, subtitle), then `Container` with `<Suspense>` streamed content, then usually `CtaBand`.

- work: `WorkGrid` with `searchParams` stack/year chips; `listPublished` + `listWorkFacets`.
- blog: search form, type/tag chips, featured hero card, `Pagination`.
- learn: `listSeries` + standalone tutorials.
- services: `ServicesGrid` (`listServices`, ItemList JSON-LD), a static 4-step process, `Faq`.
- about: `AboutIntro` (profile plus the 'about' page post), values grid, `StatsStrip`, `CtaBand`.
- contact: `DirectContact` + `ContactForm`, preselecting a service via `?service=`.

Detail pages (`blog/[slug]`, `work/[slug]`, `services/[slug]`, `learn/[series]`, `learn/[series]/[lesson]`) use `<Suspense fallback={<ArticleSkeleton/>}>{params.then(...)}`.

Also: `not-found.tsx` (404 with a `gt-accent` '404'), `[...rest]/page.tsx` (calls `notFound()`), and `opengraph-image.tsx`.

Every function is `'use cache'` + `cacheTag(CONTENT_TAG='content')`. `contentLife()` shortens the cache lifetime when a scheduled post is about to go live. Callers must be request-time (`connection()` first).

Used on home: `getPublicProfile` (tags content and settings; `cacheLife` hours), `listPublicClientNames`, `listPublished`, `listServices`, `getSiteStats` (tags content and stats; `cacheLife` days), `listSeries`, `getSeriesWithLessons`, `listTestimonials` (hours).

Types: `PostCard`, `PostDetail`, `SeriesCard`.

- Tokens: `@theme inline` maps CSS vars to Tailwind. `:root` has a green primary (#00a76f) plus `--primary-rgb`. `.dark` overrides. Six `[data-preset]` blocks (cyan, purple, blue, orange, red; orange sets `--primary-foreground:#1c252e`). Minimals greys `--color-grey-50..900`. Shadows `card`, `dropdown`, `dialog`, `primary`. Animations `--animate-marquee`, `float`, `pulse-ring`, `dash`, `shimmer`.
- Global `prefers-reduced-motion` kill switch in `@layer base`.
- Utilities: `.bg-soft-primary`, `.bg-grid` (48px, `--surface-grid`), `.bg-dots` (20px), `.mask-fade-b`, `.mask-fade-y`, `.mask-fade-x`, `.mask-radial`, `.text-gradient`, `.glass` (72% background + blur 12px + saturate), `.scrollbar-none`, `.scrollbar-thin`.
- `.prose-gt` long-form styles (headings `scroll-margin-top: 6rem`; pre forced ltr).
- Site block `/* ─── site ─── */ … /* ─── /site ─── */` (keep additions inside it): `.gt-wordmark`, `.gt-accent` (+ rtl variant), `.gt-dot`, `.gt-glow` (absolute, blur 80px), `.gt-packet`, `.gt-ants`, `.gt-live`, `.gt-rise`, `.gt-draw`, `.gt-mobile-menu` (+ `:popover-open` + `.gt-menu-item`), `.gt-marquee`, `.gt-marquee-wrap`, `.gt-lift`, `.gt-ring`, `.gt-faq`, plus prose anchor niceties.

files.role: Brand mark (needs replacing with the pixel logo)
files.notes: `LogoMark` is an SVG of two rounded squares using `var(--primary)`; `Logo({label})` adds the wordmark text. Used in the site header and footer, hero-diagram, panel `sidebar.tsx`, the (auth) layout, `p/[token]`, `i/[token]`, `sign/[token]`, `contracts/contract-sheet.tsx` and `finance/invoice-document.tsx`.

Pixel wordmark: GOOD in yellow #FFC50D, IN in dark grey #6A6A6C, STUDIO in light grey #CACCCE, inside a window-like frame (top and left bars #B3B5B9, corner #6A6A6C) on #F3F3F3. Includes a swatch row.
Both hard-code the old green mark. The manifest has `theme_color #00a76f`, `short_name` = `common.appName`, and `name` = `site.metaTitle`.

Vazirmatn (fa), Public Sans (en) and JetBrains Mono, all from @fontsource-variable woff2 (no network at build time). Exposed as `--font-vazirmatn`, `--font-public-sans` and `--font-jetbrains-mono` through `fontVariables`. A pixel display font would be added here the same way.

- theme.ts: `colorPresets` (green, cyan, purple, blue, orange, red), `presetSwatches`, `PRESET_STORAGE_KEY='gt-preset'`, `presetInitScript`.
- theme-controls.tsx: `usePreset` (a MutationObserver on `<html data-preset>`), `ThemeToggle`, `AppearanceMenu` (Popover + ToggleGroup).

- fa is the source of truth; en is typed `Record<keyof typeof fa, string>`. site.ts is about 300 lines.
- Brand strings: `common.appName` is 'گود تیم' / 'Good Team'; `common.appTagline`; `site.metaTitle` / `metaDescription`.
- `getLocale()` uses `next/root-params`; `getMessages`; `pickMessages`.
- Client: `useT` / `useLocale` / `useI18n`.
- config.ts: `localePath(locale, path)` (fa has no prefix), `stripLocale`, `localeMeta` (dir, calendar, label).
- The `useT` doc comment says the site ships `site`, but the layout actually ships only `common` and `nav`.

files.role: Profile settings consumed by the site
files.notes: `settingsSchemas.profile` defaults `brandName` to {fa:'گود تیم', en:'Good Team'}. Fields: `ownerName`, `headline`, `bio`, `avatarUrl`, `email`, `phone`, `location`, `socials` (x, linkedin, github, telegram, instagram, youtube) and `availableForWork`. A virtual-me assistant could reuse `ownerName`, `avatarUrl` and `headline`.
`cacheComponents: true`, `partialPrefetching: true`, `output: standalone`. Images: avif and webp; `localPatterns` `/media/**` and `/brand/**`. Sets `X-Accel-Buffering: no` for streaming.
Playwright screenshots of fa/en pages with `--dark`, `--mobile` and `--full`. The only e2e spec is `e2e/vault.spec.ts`, so the site has no browser tests.

constraints: Cache Components: DB reads must happen in an async server component that calls `await connection()` first, inside `<Suspense>`. Use the `'use cache'` functions from content/queries.ts and never query in the static shell.

Never use `new Date()` or `Date.now()` in static chrome. A menu-bar clock must be a client island that renders the time after mount (useEffect or useSyncExternalStore with a server snapshot) and sits inside `<Suspense>`. Use the `CurrentYear` 'use cache' pattern for date strings that may be cached.

`usePathname()` and `useSearchParams()` in any new client chrome (dock active state, menu-bar title) must render inside `<Suspense>` with a non-active fallback, the same way `NavLinks` and `LanguageMenu` do.

The `(site)` route group has no loading.tsx. Pages rely on per-component Suspense with skeletons sized to match the real content (no CLS). Keep that, or add boundaries deliberately; Next 16.4 validates instant navigations.

Locale switching must stay a plain `<a href hrefLang>`, not a `<Link>`. It is a full reload because html lang, dir and fonts change, and a `<Link>` prefetch across root params 404s in Next 16.4. Reuse `useAlternates` and `staticSitePaths`.

The 64px sticky header height (`h-16`) is coupled to several places: hero and PageHero background layers at `-top-16`, sticky asides at `top-24` (about, ArticleBody TOC, lesson sidebar), `.prose-gt` headings `scroll-margin-top: 6rem`, Toc `rootMargin -80px`, and the MobileMenu's `h-16` top row. Changing it means updating all of them.

A fixed bottom dock will cover the footer bottom bar and the last section. Add matching bottom padding or a spacer to `<main>`/footer, respect `env(safe-area-inset-bottom)`, and keep `<main id="main">` as the skip-link target.
`<main>` has `overflow-x-clip`, which fixed horizontal overflow on phones (commit a6c58c1). Background glow layers (`gt-glow`) and absolutely positioned diagram parts depend on it.

RTL first: use logical utilities only (`ms-`, `me-`, `ps-`, `pe-`, `start-`, `end-`, `inset-inline`). On the site, arrows (`ArrowUpLeftIcon`, `ChevronLeftIcon`) are drawn for RTL and corrected with `ltr:rotate-90` / `ltr:rotate-180`. The hero SVG mirrors with `rtl:-scale-x-100`. Centering with `-translate-x-1/2` needs `rtl:translate-x-1/2`. Marquees, terminals and charts force `dir=ltr`, with items set to `dir=auto`.

i18n: no hard-coded UI strings. Add keys to `fa/<ns>.ts` (source of truth) and `en/<ns>.ts`, and register new namespaces (for example an `assistant` namespace) in `src/i18n/messages/index.ts`. The public layout ships only `common` and `nav` to the client. Pass assistant copy as props or add the namespace to `pickMessages` deliberately, keeping the payload small.

Performance: the public site keeps tooltips and toasts out (`InteractiveProviders` is panel-only, commit d203d76). Animations are CSS-only, with a global `prefers-reduced-motion` kill switch. Islands receive labels as props. HowWeWork and FAQ use no JS. New features (dock magnification, assistant) should follow the same rules: CSS-first, one shared IntersectionObserver, idle-time mount (`requestIdleCallback`, as `ViewTracker` does), and no heavy animation libraries.
Tailwind v4 cannot detect interpolated class names. Use literal maps like `tabCls` in how-we-work.tsx for any per-section or per-state classes.

Theme: next-themes uses the `.dark` class (`@custom-variant dark`), and the color preset is `<html data-preset>` applied by `presetInitScript` before paint. A yellow #FFC50D primary needs a dark `--primary-foreground` (#1c252e, as in the orange preset). Yellow text on white is low contrast, so review uses of `text-primary` (stats '+', ArrowLink hover, CheckIcons, TypeBadge `text-primary-dark`).

The brand is hard-coded outside tokens in: `components/brand/logo.tsx`, `src/app/icon.svg`, `og.tsx` (SVG plus green and violet colors), `manifest.ts` `theme_color`, `[locale]/layout.tsx` `viewport.themeColor`, the `cover.tsx` palette, `#8e33ff` in `.gt-accent`, `.gt-ring` and hero-diagram, settings default `brandName`, `common.appName`, and `site.metaTitle`. LogoMark is also used in panel, contract, invoice, sign and portal pages.

OG images are rendered by Satori: TTF fonts only (`public/fonts/og`), Persian must be pre-shaped with `arabic-shaping.ts`, no CSS `inset`, and glows must be full-canvas layers. A pixel logo there must be inline SVG rects.

Keep site CSS additions inside the `/* ─── site ─── */ … /* ─── /site ─── */` block in globals.css. If components in `components/ui` or `components/shared` change (for example a shared menu bar or dock), update the `/panel/design-system` catalog examples.

SEO, AEO and GEO must survive the redesign: JSON-LD (SiteJsonLd in the layout, per-page ItemList, Article, FAQ, Breadcrumb), real `<h1>`/`<h2>` hierarchy (`SectionHeading as`), `.md` mirrors via proxy.ts, the `h-entry` / `p-name` / `e-content` microformats on posts, and `aria-label`s on sections. An assistant bubble must be `aria-live=polite` (or decorative) and must not hijack focus.

The mobile menu uses the native Popover API (`popover=auto`, `id=site-mobile-menu`, `popoverTarget`), which gives light dismiss, Esc and top layer with no dialog library. It closes on navigation via `CloseOnNavigate`. A replacement (for example a dock on phones) should keep that zero-dependency approach.

panel.summary:
The panel chrome is one layout, `src/app/[locale]/panel/layout.tsx`. It wraps I18nProvider (all message namespaces), then the pre-paint `InlineScript(sidebarInitScript)`, then InteractiveProviders (TooltipProvider and Toaster; the public site has neither), then PanelUIProvider. Inside that is a flex row with the sidebar on the start side and a column holding the header and `<main id="main">`.

The frame itself is static and prerendered. Anything that needs the session streams in through two Suspense islands:
- **`<SessionSidebar/>`**, which falls back to `<SidebarSkeleton/>`. It reads the actor plus the `gt-sidebar-collapsed` cookie and renders PanelSidebar and the ⌘K CommandPalette.
- **`<SessionHeaderSlot/>`**, which falls back to `<HeaderSlotSkeleton/>`. It renders HeaderWidgets (HeaderLive: TimerPill for staff and NotificationsBell, polling every 60 s) and UserMenu.

`PanelHeader` is a client component, sticky and glass, 64px tall (72px on lg). From the start side it holds: the mobile hamburger (opens a Sheet drawer), a search button that opens ⌘K, then LocaleSwitcher, AppearanceMenu and the session slot.

Navigation comes from `nav-config.ts` (`panelNav` filtered by `navForRole`). It feeds the sidebar, the mobile sheet and the palette:
- owner/admin: 16 items
- member: 9 items
- client: 5 items (My projects, Projects, Invoices, Contracts, Settings)

Client users land on `ClientPortalHome`, and their header hides the timers.

A macOS-style shell maps cleanly onto this:
- **Menu bar:** replaces PanelHeader. The nav groups become its menus, and the existing widgets become the status icons on its end side.
- **Dock:** replaces the desktop sidebar and keeps the role filter. On phones it becomes a tab bar plus a Sheet.

The redesign must keep the Suspense and cookie/pre-paint patterns, ⌘K, the `#main` landmark and the i18n aria labels. It must also re-home CommandPalette and fix the sticky offsets that depend on header height. Finally, nothing it adds may break `e2e/vault.spec.ts` (an unscoped `getByRole('dialog')`, and clicks that the dock could cover) or `scripts/shots.mjs` (which fails on console errors and 4xx responses).

theme.summary: Theming is plain CSS variables in src/app/globals.css, with shadcn-style semantic tokens mapped to Tailwind v4 in `@theme inline`. The look follows Minimals: blue-grey neutrals and a green #00a76f primary. Dark mode is the `.dark` class set by next-themes (attribute="class", defaultTheme="system"). The primary colour scale (lighter/light/main/dark/darker/foreground/rgb) changes per preset through `<html data-preset>`. The default ("green") lives in `:root` and is applied before paint by `presetInitScript` (theme.ts), which runs in the head of src/app/[locale]/layout.tsx. design-tokens.ts repeats every token value as data, and design-tokens.test.ts parses globals.css to block any drift between the two. The brand mark is one SVG component, LogoMark/Logo in src/components/brand/logo.tsx, coloured with var(--primary) and used in 11 places. Copies of it with hard-coded colours sit in src/app/icon.svg and og.tsx. The brand name has two sources. The first is the i18n constant `common.appName` ("گود تیم" / "Good Team"), used for the site and panel chrome and metadata. The second is the editable DB value `settings.profile.brandName`, used for invoices, contracts, the RSS feed, llms.txt and JSON-LD, with appName as the fallback. Many `gt_`/`gt-`/`good-team`/`goodteam` identifiers are cookies, the API token prefix, storage keys, the vault backup format, calendar UIDs, the Docker volume and demo credentials. These must not be renamed. Brand yellow #FFC50D fails as text in light mode: 1.59:1 on white and 1.43:1 on #F3F3F3. White text on yellow is also 1.59:1. So yellow can be a fill, a fill behind dark text, or a text/accent colour in dark mode (11:1 on #141a21). Light-mode text, links, rings and chart marks need a darker shade: #7A5A00 for text (6.4:1 on white) and #9A7200 for rings and chart marks. The 128 `text-primary` uses and the Button hover state need new tokens.

reference.summary:
The reference page (cloudflare.com/products/agents/) was measured live in the browser at 1440×900 and 375×812, in dark and light themes. Notes come from computed styles and stylesheets. WebFetch only returned the AI-facing markdown mirror, so it was not useful.

**How the reference is built**
- One 1200px column with two full-height dashed rails, drawn with CSS (dashes 16px long, 16px apart).
- Every section is a separate box with a 1px border, sitting 48, 64 or 80px apart depending on screen width.
- Inside the boxes, grids go from 1 to 3 columns. Cells are split by 1px lines, and every cell corner has a 14px square marker.
- A 12px dot texture fills only the margins and bands, never the area behind text.
- Type is one grotesk in weights 400/500 plus one mono font, at 56/48/32/19/16/13px.
- There is one accent colour, plus a pill-shaped orange CTA panel at the end.

**The pattern that fits the "virtual me" assistant**
Cloudflare runs fake multiplayer "agent cursors". Each is an orange arrow with a label like "Editing card…" or "Setting section title…". The arrow moves with `translate3d` on a page-sized overlay that ignores clicks. The section it reaches gets CSS-only selection effects: a dashed outline, 7px corner handles, a tint, and a lift with a small wiggle. Sections fade in through CSS scroll-driven animations (`animation-timeline: view()`) with a fallback for older browsers. Everything is turned off for reduced-motion users, and the cursors are hidden below 768px.

**Repo map**
- **Public site:** `SiteHeader`/`HeaderShell`, `SiteFooter`, `home/sections.tsx`, which already uses Suspense and skeletons, and `hero-diagram.tsx`, which is already a Cloudflare-style diagram.
- **Panel:** `PanelSidebar`, `PanelHeader`, `CommandPalette`, and `nav-config.ts`, which is the single source of panel navigation.
- **Theme:** `theme-controls.tsx`, with green as the default preset.
- **Brand files (untracked):** `pixel-logo.tsx`, `pixel-font.ts` and `docs/brand/logo-reference.webp` appeared during this run, probably from a parallel step. They draw `PixelLogo({suffix})` for any sub-brand, but `globals.css` does not define the `--brand-*` variables they use yet.
